```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(reticulate)

use_virtualenv("./.venv", required = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r load-data, include = FALSE}
flights_data <- read_csv("data/cleaned/flights_with_weather.csv")
```

```{r visualization, echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# a histogram of wind speeds at departure
ggplot(flights_data, aes(x = wind_speed_10m)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 2, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Wind Speeds at Departure",
    subtitle = paste("Based on", nrow(flights_data), "recorded flights"),
    x = "Wind Speed (km/h)",
    y = "Frequency"
  )
```

```{r top-windy-airports, echo = FALSE}
# average wind speed per airport
windy_airports <- flights_data |>
  group_by(departure_iata) |>
  summarise(
    avg_wind = mean(wind_speed_10m, na.rm = TRUE),
    flight_count = n()
  ) |>
  filter(flight_count > 5) |>
  arrange(desc(avg_wind))

head(windy_airports)
```

## Python
```{python}
import pandas as pd
from pathlib import Path

data_path = Path("data/cleaned/flights_with_weather.csv")

py_flights = pd.read_csv(data_path)

print(f"{len(py_flights)} rows loaded.")
```

## R
```{r}
flights_from_python <- py$py_flights
```

```{r time-transformation}
library(lubridate)

flights_from_python <- flights_from_python |>
  mutate(
    dep_time_clean = as_datetime(departure_estimated),
    hour_of_day = hour(dep_time_clean),
    day_of_week = wday(dep_time_clean, label = TRUE)
  )

hourly_delay <- flights_from_python |>
  group_by(hour_of_day) |>
  summarise(
    avg_delay = mean(departure_delay, na.rm = TRUE),
    flight_count = n()
  ) |>
  arrange(hour_of_day)

na.omit(hourly_delay)
```
